description: Provision an AWS Prometheusservice LoggingConfiguration via the ACK prometheusservice controller. Fields mirror the prometheusservice.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1 LoggingConfiguration spec.

logGroupARN.description:
The ARN of the CloudWatch log group to which the vended log data will be
published. This log group must exist prior to calling this operation.

Regex Pattern: `^arn:aws[a-z0-9-]*:logs:[a-z0-9-]+:\d{12}:log-group:[A-Za-z0-9\.\-\_\#/]{1,512}\:\*$`

region.description: AWS region for this resource (e.g. eu-west-1). Rendered as the services.k8s.aws/region annotation. Empty inherits the ACK controller's default region.
region.title: AWS region

workspaceID.description:
The ID of the workspace to create the logging configuration for.

Regex Pattern: `[0-9A-Za-z][-.0-9A-Z_a-z]*`
